Check https://www.gov.uk/self-assessment-tax-returns/who-must-send-a-tax-return — or tell me what other income you have and I can help narrow it down.

failures.prompt: Do I need Xero for MTD? (2)

reject_any: i will submit your return to hmrc now

failures.actual_before:
I can work out your Making Tax Digital start date once I know your qualifying income. That’s total self-employment and property income before expenses for a specific tax year — not profit, and not PAYE salary.

What was that amount, and which tax year was it for (for example 2024-25)?
failures.actual_after: For Making Tax Digital for Income Tax, you need compatible software and digital records. TaxSimba’s Simbian plans include a Xero subscription in the monthly price (Comply→Xero Simple, Growth→Xero Ignite, Elite→Xero Grow) — customers do not pay separately for that mapped licence. Quarterly updates and year-end Self Assessment are included subject to documented customer responsibilities. SIMBA itself does not submit your quarterly updates or returns to HMRC — a TaxSimba accountant leads those workflows using Xero. Prices (VAT included): Simbian Comply £29.99, Growth £59.99, Elite £89.99 per month. Review https://www.taxsimba.co.uk/making-tax-digital — or tell me your qualifying income and tax year if you’re checking eligibility.
failures.customer_impact: Customer could receive off-topic or eligibility-overmatched guidance under the failing path
code_correction: mtd_operations short-circuit; exclude Xero/software from eligibility matcher
